spec: KE2 web simulator - data needed from the NSE feed infra
notes: The simulator computes its own IVs / deltas from PRICES (running DTE, r = 0, stock options vs their future, NIFTY vs the synthetic future) so code, sim and backtest stay identical. Feed IV / greeks are welcome as extra fields for cross-checks, not used for decisions.
All times IST, ISO-8601 with milliseconds. Prices in rupees (not paise).
One expiry per cycle: the monthly expiry the book is built on (e.g. 27-Oct-2026). No next-month instruments needed.
Market data only: the web simulator is a standalone replacement for the Excel simulation (same rules, simulated fills); it does not read or mirror live orders.

1_subscription_request.description: Simulator -> feed. Sent at BOD and again whenever strikes change (build, roll, replacement, wing roll). Feed answers with a snapshot of every instrument, then streams updates.

why.stock strikes_each_side 6: 10 nearest strikes for the OI x strike >= 5 cr rule (build at 15:05, rolls, replacements) + the held strike
why.NIFTY strikes_each_side 30: 0.20 / 0.25 delta wing pick + ATM strike for the synthetic future and NIFTY ATM IV
why.extra_strikes: held legs, always streamed even if the future moves away

2_instrument_master.description: Feed -> simulator, once per day before 09:00 (and on request). Static data for every subscribable F&O instrument of the expiry.

3_market_update.description: Feed -> simulator, streamed on every change (or conflated to max 1 per second per instrument). One message can carry many instruments.

required_fields.bid / ask: simulated fills (sell at bid, buy at ask, as the Excel sim) and the synthetic NIFTY future (ATM + CE ask - PE ask)
required_fields.oi: strike rule OI x strike >= 5 cr (either leg) at build / roll / replacement
required_fields.exchange_ts / last_trade_ts: minute bars (last tick of minute m = bar m+1), stale-price checks
required_fields.volume: traded / not-traded flag for the EOD mark

4_minute_bar.description: Optional but preferred: feed (or a small aggregator) emits a bar per instrument at each minute end, built as last tick of minute m = bar labelled m+1 (same rule as the tick-by-tick backtest). The simulator's checkpoints, 5-minute IV-exit median, roll checks and logs run on these.

5_end_of_day.description: Feed / file -> simulator after the close (NSE bhavcopy equivalent). Used for BOD rebase, carry, IV mark (down-only), r0', opening-hedge alignment, wing IV decision, replacement ranking.
5_end_of_day.why_value_lakh: universe = top 80 by option traded value over the 14-day window before the build

6_reference_daily.description: Feed / file -> simulator, each morning (and intraday when they change).

why.fo_ban_list: ban exit (square off at the last checkpoint before the ban day), replacement filter
why.results_intimations: earnings exit at the first checkpoint after an intimation; build / replacement exclusion (results up to the expiry day)

7_transport.recommended: WebSocket (JSON messages above) from the feed infra to the simulator backend; the backend serves the browser over its own WebSocket / REST.
7_transport.rates: quotes conflated to <= 1 per second per instrument is enough; ~50 stocks x ~13 contracts + NIFTY ~120 contracts = ~800 instruments
7_transport.recovery: on reconnect the feed re-sends a full snapshot of all subscribed instruments (same 'quote' message, flag "snapshot": true)
